Insider trading allows you to cheat your way to lots of money at the expense of others by having access to corporate secrets that the general public does not have access to ( e.g. because you work for the company you are investing in ) and using that knowledge to buy and sell shares precisely when it 's most advantageous . Now , what does " sell " actually mean , it means you are selling this stock to another individual .
